name: claude-mods
description: A collection of Claude Code mods: hooks-module plugins that add panes, status entries, commands and tool-call hooks, and skill packs that add workflows.

plugins.name: image-preview
plugins.description: Preview images pasted into the prompt box before you send them (Ghostty / kitty only).

plugins.name: desktop-statusline
plugins.description: A status line for the Claude desktop app: 5-hour and weekly limits, context, cost, and how long the 5-hour limit will last.

plugins.name: clef-guard
plugins.description: Has Cloudflare's Clef decision model judge each Bash, Write, Edit and WebFetch call, and asks you itself before risky or always-ask operations.

plugins.name: clef-verify
plugins.description: Before Claude ends a turn that changed files, has Cloudflare's Clairic read the test output and Clef check that tests were run and passed where needed and that the reply is backed by the steps, and sends Claude back with the evidence if not.

plugins.name: devflow
plugins.description: A spec-driven, test-driven workflow: /devflow:go routes a task to a track, sizes it, and runs only the stages it needs (spec, plan, TDD build, prove, ship), with a band above the prompt showing the route and the running stage. Each stage is its own skill.
